toasts.label: Notifications
syncStatus.pausedCapture: Sync paused: older sync history may be missing edits made while signed out. Your local data is retained. Use Settings → General → Sync history recovery to download a verified archive and reconcile before resuming.
syncStatus.pausedHistory: Sync paused because the server history changed or recovery was requested. Your local edits are retained. Use Settings → General → Sync history recovery to download a verified archive and review conflicts before resuming.
syncStatus.pausedWorkspaceMismatch: Sync paused: this workspace is bound to a different server/account, or its binding is invalid. Your local data and queued edits are preserved. Export a local backup and reconnect the original server/account, or select its workspace in Settings → General. Use Sync history recovery there for unverified legacy history, after coordinating with your administrator.
syncStatus.pausedUnboundHistory: Sync paused: existing sync history has no verified server/account binding and cannot be adopted automatically. Your local data and queued edits are preserved. Export a local backup and reconnect the original server/account, or select its workspace in Settings → General. Use Sync history recovery there for unverified legacy history, after coordinating with your administrator.
syncStatus.pausedUnreadable: Sync safety state could not be read. Local edits remain on this device; reload before syncing.
syncStatus.skippedIncoming: Skipped {{item}} from the team server because this device cannot read it (items skipped: {{total}}). Everything else keeps syncing. Correct it on the device that created it to sync it again.
syncStatus.unreadableOutgoing: {{item}} was not uploaded because other devices could not read it (items held back: {{total}}). It stays saved on this device; correct it to sync it.
syncStatus.oversizedOutgoing: {{item}} was not uploaded because it exceeds the team server's limits (items held back: {{total}}). It stays saved on this device; shorten it to sync it.
syncStatus.previewTypeOutgoing: {{item}} was not uploaded because the team server accepts only PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP preview images (items held back: {{total}}). It stays saved on this device.
syncStatus.heldBlocksLocalCopyRemoval: The local copy was not removed: {{count}} item(s) in this investigation have changes that sync keeps on this device because the team server cannot accept them ({{items}}). Delete them permanently (moving them to the trash is not enough) or edit them so they can upload (for example, shorten very long text), then retry.
syncStatus.rejectedInvalid: The team server refused this change as invalid ({{reason}}). It remains saved on this device; correct it to sync it.
syncStatus.theirsUnreadable: This device cannot read the team server's version, so only your version can be kept.
draftRecovery.message: Some changes could not be saved. Drafts are kept only in this tab. Retry or download them before closing it.
draftRecovery.discardConfirm: Discard this unsaved draft permanently? Download it first if you need a recovery copy.

offlineStatus.failedNotice: ThreatCaddy couldn't finish saving itself for offline use. It still works online and will try again next time you open it.
offlineStatus.unavailableNotice: This browser can't keep ThreatCaddy available offline. It still works online. To keep a copy of your investigations, export a JSON backup from Settings → Data.
offlineStatus.settingChecking: Checking whether this browser can keep ThreatCaddy available offline.
offlineStatus.settingInstalling: ThreatCaddy is saving itself for offline use; keep this tab open until it finishes.
offlineStatus.settingInstalled: ThreatCaddy opens in this browser without an internet connection; team sync, AI and other online services still need one.
offlineStatus.settingUnconfirmed: Offline use isn't confirmed in this browser yet. ThreatCaddy still works online and tries again next time you open it.

offlineStatus.backupNote: Offline use is not a backup. Clearing this browser's data deletes everything saved here, and browsers can also remove saved site data on their own, for example when space runs low. Export a JSON backup regularly and keep the file somewhere safe.
sync.backupWarning: Before removing local data, save and verify a full backup. Team sync cannot recover device-only details such as note folders, checklists, playbook progress and chat tool results/images. Save Backup downloads unencrypted JSON.
demoModal.reportWorkflow: Follow the linked notes from source evidence to a draft report. Review the conclusions and download the report note as Markdown; use Save Backup for the full workspace.
